task_memory: From depends_on section: short syntax only starts dependencies; long syntax adds restart: true (Compose restarts dependent service after updating a dependency, only for Compose-controlled restarts) and condition with values service_started (same as short syntax), service_healthy (wait until dependency is healthy per healthcheck), and service_completed_successfully (wait until dependency exits successfully). Startup/shutdown: Compose creates services in dependency order and removes them in reverse; with service_healthy, Compose waits for healthchecks to pass before starting dependents. Healthcheck example on services page uses fields: test, interval, timeout, retries, start_period, start_interval. Need to open healthcheck reference page to capture definitions of interval, timeout, retries, and start_period.
